scripts.build: browserify src/main.ts -p [ tsify --project 'tsconfig.json' --noImplicitAny ] > .build/ticketfetcher.js && npm run copy-css && echo 'ticket fetcher compiled'
scripts.build:dev: browserify --debug src/main.ts -p [ tsify --project 'tsconfig.json' --noImplicitAny ] > .build/ticketfetcher.js && npm run copy-css && echo 'ticket fetcher compiled'
scripts.start: npm run build:dev && open http://localhost:5000 && echo "\033[32mInspect and set Device to Responsive (1000x700)"
scripts.watch: npm run start && watch 'npm run build:dev' src
